headline: Approved Shelburne Street Roundabout as the next public art project.
summary: The committee reviewed four potential public art locations: the Shelburne Street Roundabout, City Hall Park, the New North End, and a citywide mural program. Staff presented scores for each site based on criteria, with the Shelburne Street Roundabout scoring highest at 125 points. The committee unanimously voted to move forward with the Shelburne Street Roundabout as the next public art project.
decisions: Approved the Shelburne Street Roundabout as the next public art project to move forward, by unanimous vote.

decision_evidence.quote: VOTE: Committee unanimously approved Shelburne Street Roundabout as the next public art project to move forward.

plain_text:
Public Art Committee Meeting Minutes  
September 16, 2026  1:00 PM  
Zoom Meeting  
Committee Members and Staff in Attendance:   Livia Demarchis, Sara Katz, Doreen Kraft, Max 
Madalinski, Colin Storrs,  Sarah Morgan, Debra Wilkinson,  
  
1. Call to Order:  
1. Meeting called to order at approximately 1:07 PM. 
 
2. Public Forum: 
No members of the public present 
 
3. Review of Proposed Public Art Locations 
BCA Staff presented several potential future project locations, including the Shelburne 
Street Roundabout, City Hall Park, possible unassigned sites in the New North End, and a 
mural program.  
Shelburne Street Roundabout 
• Pre-built foundation for 25’ vertical artwork; highly visible gateway. 
• Scored highest across criteria; total 125 points. 
• Committee emphasized readiness and lack of existing art in the area. 
City Hall Park 
• Existing foundation linked to historic preservation commitments. 
• Constraints on form (tall/thin). 
• Total 95 points. 
• Follow-up required to confirm historic agreement language. 
New North End 
• No existing city-funded public art; site TBD (Ethan Allen Park discouraged). 
• Gateway concepts discussed.  
• Total 108 points. 
• Low readiness; high opportunity. 
Citywide Mural Program 
• Proposed 5–8 murals per year; mobile/temporary approach. 
• Discussion of youth training component. 
• Total 105 points. 
• Committee flagged need to resolve whether murals qualify as capital assets. 
Committee suggested updates to the Public Art Matrix . 
VOTE: Committee unanimously approved Shelburne Street Roundabout as the next 
public art project to move forward. 
5. Adjournment: 
Meeting adjourned at 2:23 PM
